name: Toad-in-the-hole-lite
steps: Whisk the flour, egg and milk into a smooth batter and rest it.
Brown the sausages in a hot ovenproof dish with a little oil.
Pour the batter around the sizzling sausages.
Bake at 220C for twenty-five minutes until risen and golden.
Serve straight from the dish while puffed up.
